title: Utah Valley men's soccer announces 2026 non-conference schedule under new head coach - Beehive State News
text:
Utah Valley men’s soccer head coach Michael Chesler announced on May 20 the team’s 2026 non-conference schedule, marking the Wolverines’ first season in The Big West and Chesler’s debut as head coach.
The upcoming season will include four home games at UCCU Stadium and four road contests during the traditional non-conference portion. Additionally, Utah Valley will play three late-season matches against Pac-12 opponents through a scheduling agreement between The Big West and Pac-12. Season tickets are set to go on sale starting July 1.
The Wolverines begin their campaign with two exhibition matches: hosting Snow College on August 7, followed by a trip to Denver for a friendly against Denver University on August 14. Official competition starts with consecutive home games against Pacific Tigers (August 20) and Central Arkansas Bears (August 24), before traveling to face Santa Clara Broncos on August 30.
In September, Utah Valley hosts Omaha Mavericks from the Summit League on September 3. The team then travels for its first-ever game in West Virginia against Marshall Thundering Herd—winners of the national championship in 2020 and runners-up in 2024—on September 10. Non-conference play concludes with an away match at Utah Tech for the Old Hammer Rivalry on September 21.
Details regarding Utah Valley’s inaugural Big West conference schedule will be released soon. The team is slated to face UC Irvine, UC Santa Barbara, Sacramento State, CSUN, and three yet-to-be-finalized Pac-12 opponents later in the season.
